```{python}
import sys
import pandas as pd
sys.path.append("../../data")
from lin301 import * 
```
```{python}
hw_df = pd.read_csv("hawaiian_words.csv")
```
```{python}
hw_df["CV"] = hw_df['word'].apply(cv_pattern)
hw_df["Syllables"] = hw_df['word'].apply(syllabify)
hw_df["Syllables"] = hw_df["Syllables"].str.join(".")
hw_df["N_Syllables"] = hw_df['word'].apply(count_syllables)
print(hw_df.head())
```
```{python}
total = 0
N_Syllables = hw_df['word'].apply(syllabify)
for w in N_Syllables:
  total += len(w)
print("The average number of syllables is:", total / len(N_Syllables))
```
```{python}
most = hw_df["N_Syllables"].max()
syll_max = hw_df.loc[hw_df["N_Syllables"].idxmax(), "word"]
print("The word with the most syllables is:", syll_max, "with", most, "syllables")
```
```{python}
num_of_syl_wrds = hw_df['N_Syllables'].value_counts()
print("The number of syllables in each word is:", num_of_syl_wrds)
```
```{python}
dbl_c = hw_df["CV"].str.contains("CC")
if dbl_c is True:
  print("There are double consonants")
else:
  print("There are no double consonants.")
```
```{python}
ends_c = hw_df["CV"].str.endswith("C")
if ends_c is True:
  print("Hawaiian words can end in a consonant.")
else:
  print("Hawaiian words can't end in a consonant.")
```
```{python}

syl_df = hw_df[["Syllables", "word"]].copy()
syl_df["Syllables"] = syl_df["Syllables"].str.split(".")
syl_df = syl_df.explode("Syllables")
syl_df = syl_df.rename(columns={"word": "Word",})
print(syl_df.head(10))
```
```{python}
com = syl_df["Syllables"].value_counts().head(10)
print("The 10 most common syllables are:", com)
```
```{python}
print(cv_pattern("banana"))
print(cv_pattern("splash")) 
print(cv_pattern("strengths"))
print(syllabify("banana"))
print(syllabify("splash"))
print(syllabify("strengths"))
```
```{python}
hw_df["Syllabify_diphthongs"] = hw_df['word'].apply(syllabify_diphthongs)
```
```{python}
hw_df.to_csv("hawaiian_words.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
```
